scripts.voiceover: python3 scripts/voiceover.py full && python3 scripts/voiceover.py short
scripts.render: npm run render:full && npm run render:short
scripts.render:full: remotion render BookamPromoFull out/bookam-promo-full-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/bookam-promo-full-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/bookam-promo-full-49s.mp4
scripts.render:short: remotion render BookamPromo out/bookam-promo-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/bookam-promo-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/bookam-promo-30s.mp4
